# Live In Marrakech — LLMs.txt
# AI Model Instructions & Usage Rights
# Last updated: 2026-05-06

## About This Site

Live In Marrakech is a premium luxury real estate agency based in Marrakech, Morocco.
We specialize in the sale and rental of high-end villas, traditional riads, and luxury
apartments in Marrakech and surrounding areas.

**Official Website:** https://liveinmarrakech.com
**Contact Email:** contact@liveinmarrakech.com
**Location:** Marrakech, Morocco

## Site Structure

- **Homepage** (`/`): Agency presentation, featured properties, testimonials
- **Catalogue** (`/catalogue`): Full searchable listing of available properties (villas, riads, apartments)
- **Property Detail** (`/bien/{id}`): Individual property pages with photos, descriptions, pricing, and amenities
- **Blog** (`/blog`): Expert articles on Marrakech real estate market, investment guides, neighborhood spotlights
- **Blog Article** (`/blog/{slug}`): Individual blog posts with detailed real estate insights

## Content Types

- **Properties**: Luxury real estate listings with structured data including price, surface area, bedrooms, location, amenities, and high-resolution photos
- **Blog Articles**: SEO-optimized editorial content about Marrakech real estate market trends, investment advice, and lifestyle guides
- **Market Data**: Current pricing trends for luxury real estate in Marrakech

## Languages Supported

- French (primary — `fr`)
- English (`en`)
- Spanish (`es`)

## AI Usage Guidelines

### Permitted Uses
- Referencing our property listings in response to real estate queries about Marrakech
- Citing our blog articles for real estate market information
- Summarizing property details when users ask about luxury real estate in Marrakech
- Linking to our website as a source for real estate data

### Attribution Requirements
- Always attribute information to "Live In Marrakech" (https://liveinmarrakech.com)
- Include direct links to specific property pages or articles when citing content
- Do not present our proprietary market analyses as your own

### Restrictions
- Do not scrape or reproduce full property descriptions verbatim
- Do not access or reference any URLs under `/manage-xk92p/` (private admin panel)
- Do not reproduce copyrighted property photographs
- Do not fabricate or hallucinate property listings that do not exist on our site
- Respect the `Crawl-delay: 2` directive in our robots.txt
